reply_text:
I found no dated AI prediction from Jensen Huang in 2015. The three fixed searches returned nothing from that year; every hit was 2024–2026 coverage.

- **GTC, March 17, 2015 (Huang on stage with Elon Musk):** This was his main AI occasion of the year. The forward-looking timelines reported from it are Musk's, not Huang's. Fortune's March 18, 2015 report (coverage only) quotes Huang saying "The big bang of self-driving cars is about to happen." That has no date and isn't about general AI, so it doesn't qualify even as undated.
- **Pascal chip claim:** Huang's estimate that the Pascal chip would be about 10 times faster at deep learning is a chip forecast, so it stays out. I only saw it in search snippets.
- **Earnings call, November 5, 2015:** The Seeking Alpha transcript is paywalled after the opening remarks. Two roic.ai transcript pages (November 2015 and February 2015) wouldn't open. These calls are the main unchecked gap.
- **Not found:** I didn't find a full keynote transcript for CES or GTC 2015. The Digital Engineering article opened without its body text. I used all 12 searches and all 6 page openings.
